request.query: Explain UPI Lite in simple words.

claims.text: UPI Lite is a feature within the UPI app that acts like an on-device wallet for making small value payments.
It allows users to store funds directly on their phone and make transactions without needing an internet connection or entering a UPI PIN.
Users can load money into this wallet from their bank account, but adding funds requires online authentication like a passcode or biometric scan.
The system currently allows spending up to ₹1,000 per transaction with a total stored limit of ₹5,000 at any time.

reasons: The local model accepted the selected evidence as support.

CO.DPSS.POLC.No. S1264/ 02-14-003/2021-2022 titled “Framework for facilitating small value digital payments in offline mode” dated 3rd January 2022, NPCI has designed the “UPI Lite – On-Device wallet” (“UPI Lite”) functionality for UPI user (User). In phase 1, UPI Lite will process transactions in near offline mode i.e. debit offline and credit online, and at a later point, UPI Lite will process transactions in complete offline mode i.e. debit and credit both offline. A User of UPI App will have the option to enable UPI Lite i.e. “On-Device wallet” on her/his UPI App. Once enabled, the User can allocate funds from her/his bank account to UPI Lite. quotes.quote: 1. As per the latest notification issued by RBI on 4th December 2024 vide circular no. RBI/2021-22/146 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S1264/02-14-003/2021-2022 with subject ‘Framework for Facilitating Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, for UPI LITE, the enhanced limits shall be ₹1,000 per transaction with ₹5,000 being the total limit. Replenishment of used limit shall be allowed only in online mode with AFA. Customer will further have the option to set Auto Top-up for limit replenishment as per NPCI circular, ‘Introduction of Auto Top-up on UPI LITE’, vide No. NPCI/UPI/OC No. 205/2024-25, dated 27th August 2024. The details of the LITE limits are as below: | Description | UPI LITE — Existing | UPI LITE — New | UPI LITE X (Offline) — No Change | |---|---|---|---| | Per Transaction Limit | ₹500 | ₹1000 | ₹500 | | Total Limit at any point in time | ₹2000 | ₹5000 | ₹2000 | The new limits shall apply to and govern all existing NPCI circulars pertaining to UPI LITE limit (Annexure A). All the members are required to make the necessary changes pertaining to limit increase immediately.
